data.wake_minutes: Minutes of presence to count as awake
data.start_timeout: Minutes to wait for the robot to start before retrying
data.job_done_delay: Minutes docked before a job counts as done

data_description.quiet_start: No cleaning between start and end, not even after a deadline.
data_description.wake_sensors: On the selected days, cleaning starts only after one of these sensors has detected someone for the given minutes (for example breakfast in the kitchen). Leave empty to skip the check.
data_description.work_mode_entity: A select entity of the robot that switches between vacuum only and vacuum and mop.
data_description.job_done_delay: Used only without a cleaning job sensor. Robots that wash the mop go back to the dock during a job: the job counts as done only after the robot stays docked this long. A return to recharge also counts as the end.
data_description.battery_entity: For robots that report the battery in a separate sensor.
data_description.finished_event: An event entity of the robot that fires when a job ends. Event types finished and finished_with_warnings mark the job as done right away; other types mark it as stopped.
data_description.job_entity: A binary sensor of the robot that is on from the start to the end of a cleaning job, also while the robot is at the dock in the middle of it. When set, it decides when a job is over, and a job started elsewhere (app, schedule) keeps the robot busy.
